project: Belirsizlik Altında Cevap Vermekten Kaçınan Yapay Zekâ
purpose: Confirm whether a usable Python 3.7.3 interpreter is discoverable without running candidate tests.
diagnosis: Python 3.7.3 exists and runs. The prior Keras-7 screen stopped because it treated sys._base_executable=null as proof that the interpreter was unavailable and did not inspect the existing base_prefix executable paths.
limitation: A new isolated venv has not yet been created in this discovery step. Python 3.7.3 discovery is confirmed; isolated environment creation should be verified separately with a case-independent smoke check before attempting any candidate test pair.
